faqs: Do AI video ads actually perform?
They can perform as well as shot videos when the script, hook and offer are strong. The biggest advantage is volume: you can test many more ideas, which is how winning ads are found.
Will viewers know the ad was made with AI?
We aim for natural, on-brand videos and mix in real footage, product shots and real customer proof where trust matters. We don't create fake testimonials.
Are AI video ads allowed on Facebook and Instagram?
Yes. Meta allows AI-assisted ads, and some kinds of realistic AI content need to be labelled. We follow the current platform rules for every ad.
Do you also run the ads?
Yes. We make the creatives and run the campaigns, so we can see which videos bring leads or sales and make more like them.
